request.text:
Employee ticket:
My keyboard types @ when I press the quote key and I can't find the pound sign.

Knowledge base:
[1] Keyboard types the wrong symbols · Fix
## Fix
If @ and " are swapped, the layout is set to US instead of UK. On Windows open **Settings > Time & language > Language & region** and set the keyboard to "United Kingdom". On a Mac open **System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources** and add "British".

[2] External monitor not detected on the dock · Fix
## Fix
1. Check the monitor is on the right input (DisplayPort or HDMI).
2. Unplug the laptop from the dock and plug it back in.
3. On Windows press **Win + P** and choose **Extend**. On a Mac open **System Settings > Displays** and click **Detect Displays** while holding Option.

[3] Account locked after failed sign-ins · Why it happens
## Why it happens
Ten failed sign-ins in 15 minutes lock the account for 30 minutes. A phone or tablet with an old password saved is the most common cause.
